result.topic_en: Brief notes on a Riemann-problem-type setup for gas dynamics: two states (velocity u, density ρ) separated by a discontinuity, with log ρ, and a simple-wave relation x − (u − a)t = f(q) = 0 and u = 2a(p₁ − q).

methods.what: Initial discontinuity setup: left state (u1, rho1) and right state (u2, rho2)
Simple (rarefaction) wave characteristic relation: x − (u − a)t is a function of q, here set to zero (centered wave)
Riemann-invariant relation giving velocity in terms of logarithmic density variables
